verified_findings.claim: The previously unidentified ninth 1952 vice-presidential candidate was 임영신 (任永信, Yim Young-shin/Louise Yim). A collected diplomatic document explicitly lists nine candidates, while the July 25 Rhee-correspondence collection independently indexes her in a candidate-introduction attachment.

The August 13 public chronology's eight displayed vice-presidential vote totals are incomplete as a candidate list; they must not be used to infer only eight candidates because the nine-candidate document and July 25 candidate attachment establish Yim's candidacy.

Election administration should be modeled as a chain of local polling/counting committees, provincial committees, Home Ministry-linked administration and final legislative announcement, rather than attributed wholesale to the president.

A Liberal Party committee filed an election-law complaint against Chang Taek-sang, Kim Tae-son and a police chief immediately after polling. This is evidence of a contemporaneous intra-government/party dispute, not proof that the accused violated the law.

Kim Tae-son's indexed August 12 instruction to halt election-offense investigations creates a distinct enforcement-authority event that must be separated from voting, counting and campaign-condition claims.

adversarial_checks.claim: There were only eight vice-presidential candidates because eight vote totals appear in the August 13 chronology.
All election administration can be directly attributed to Rhee.
The Liberal Party uniformly controlled all executive actors during the election.
The August 6 complaint proves election-law violations by the prime minister, home minister or police chief.
Kim Tae-son's August 12 instruction necessarily proves suppression of valid cases.

adversarial_checks.claim: The campaign field was simply Rhee versus a unified opposition.

history_debt_updates.reason: Ninth vice-presidential candidate identified as Yim Young-shin from two distinct NIHK-held document families; her official registration original and final vote total remain outstanding.
Contemporaneous complaint and Home Minister investigation-halt lead now create a concrete enforcement chain, but legal authority, implementation and case dispositions remain unresolved.

limitations: The 40-document floor was not reached in the available execution window. Direct NEC automated access remained partly blocked. This pass prioritized resolving the ninth-candidate provenance gap and opening a new election-enforcement chain without padding counts. Candidate originals, full July 28 articles and the August 12 order remain next-run primary targets.
